blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Maritime Industry Authority (MARINA) has ordered the suspension of the Passenger Ship Safety Certificate (PSSC) of MV OceanJet 168 following a fire incident aboard the vessel on Sunday morning. The suspension was ordered as MARINA investigates to determine the cause of the fire and assess possible administrative violations under existing maritime safety regulations. Citing initial reports, MARINA said the fire broke out in the vessel’s engine room at around 10:40 a.m. while it was sailing from Cebu City to Ormoc City with 326 passengers on board.
